meta.band_definition: the FAMILY band stays F0 vs F1 (the definition does not move); the other pairs are diagnostics
meta.band_recipe: compute_band() is imported from candidate_level_noise.py, not re-implemented
meta.selection_recipe: within a pool all candidates share the iteration base, so ranking by post_wns and ranking by the base-referenced marginal delta give the same order; the tool therefore works on post_wns
meta.completeness_rule: a band is only labelled a FAMILY band when both of its sides are complete against the job table that promised them; a partial band is printed but excluded from the stability ratio and from the three-way comparison

band_stability.interpretation: if the three pairwise spreads agree, the band is a well-defined property of the measurement; a large max/min ratio means the band DEPENDS ON WHICH PAIR of realisations was used, and every band-thresholded verdict inherits that arbitrariness
band_stability.note: the three pairwise differences are algebraically dependent (d_F0F2 = d_F0F1 + d_F1F2 per candidate), so the three estimates are NOT independent; a formal homogeneity test would be invalid and the numbers are reported as a consistency check instead

three_way_choice.method: hold out one realisation as the SCORER, let the picker use ONE realisation or the MEAN OF THE OTHER TWO, score both on the held-out one; with two realisations this comparison is a tautological tie, which is why the third one is needed

caveats: PROBE on a partially labelled family -- NOT paper evidence.
the family band DEFINITION stays F0 vs F1: the other pairs are diagnostics and do not change any verdict
the three-way comparison is about the CHOICE, measured by the regret of the pick against the best candidate in the pool under the held-out labelling
the deltas are quantised to 0.01 ns, so a regret of 0.0000 ns means "the two pickers landed on candidates that are indistinguishable at the quantum", not "the choice does not matter"

a band measured on a subset of circuits is not a band for the family: the per-circuit spread differs several-fold across circuits, so a partially finished batch gives a biased band of unknown direction

ROUNDING CONVENTION: this tool reports 2*pooled_sd of the UNROUNDED pooled sd, while candidate_level_noise.json stores the pooled sd already rounded to 6 decimals and the band is derived from that. The two can differ by 1e-6 ns (ISCAS89: 0.055543 here vs 0.055542 stored). That is a rounding artefact, not a disagreement about the measurement.
